Pairs IBD gene simply absent. Mirrors plasgenomicsutils ibd_gene_pairs, writes table TSV. pos_selection_genes() — genes hit -threshold selection signal: intersects significant SNPs genes track, counting SNP gene lands within within bp (default 2 kb, since filtering can push peak just outside gene). Pass full PF3D7_GENES track scan every gene.
